source_evidence: The services and advice your adviser provides and what fees you pay will ultimately depend on the contract you negotiate with your adviser.
question: Why should you read and understand an investment adviser’s contract before agreeing to work together?
answer: The contract you negotiate determines the services and advice the adviser will provide and the fees you will pay. Read and understand the agreement, along with the adviser’s relationship summary and Form ADV Part 2 Brochure.
